notes.title: V1.5 Update
notes.notes:
1.Add a set of NPC to show the enemy war ship for players.
2.Optimize the warship.
3.Optimize the deck dual.
4.Now the cannon will break, players need repair it before use it again. 
5.The fire on the ship can be extinguished by player using the extinguisher on the warship.
6.Warship now have for different outlook to indicate damage on ship.
7.Add a set of non-functional NPC on warship. 
8.Fix bugs.
